# Research fixture: "webdata" (SYNTHETIC)

Every file in this directory is fixture data about an invented company, Northwind Fixture Foods
(ticker NWND), and an invented rendering of the S&P 500 index: what a web search would return
(search result lists) and the pages behind those results. Every price, figure and sentence is
generated by formulas in the builder; none of it describes a real company, security or index.
JSON files carry `"fixture": true`, HTML pages carry `<meta name="bay-fixture" content="true">`;
the CSV response cannot carry a marker (its first line is its header).

It exercises data retrieval from search results: a news page, a daily price-history table, two
quarterly-results pages (periods as columns and as rows, one value in conflict, one period dated
differently) and a CSV response with daily S&P 500 values, each on its own website. It also holds
the searches a company-name lookup runs (`"Northwind"`, `"apple"`, `"Delta"`, `"Zorblax"` +
`stock ticker symbol`); those hits are never opened.

Regenerate every file with:

    cd backend && .venv/bin/python tests/fixtures/research/build_webdata.py

(`tests/test_web_data.py` checks the committed files match the builder's output byte for byte).

Layout: `pages.json` (URL -> body file), `searches.json` (query -> SearXNG-shaped results, `"*"`
is the catch-all), `pages/` (the synthetic pages).
